name: Mid-Century Butterfly
source:
In the city-state of Infinity City, each citizen has a nanochip implanted inside their body since birth, one that tracks their Reputation Level, a system that decides the kinds of opportunities that an individual can gain once they become of age in a city ruled by the Penrose Group (the 'Corporation') --- and ░░░░░░ is no exception to these rules.

Having just turning of age, she is now considered a part of the system. And while the youngsters are given a slight advantage as a 'gift' for them finally being a part of the society, things doesn't seem to look good for her. In fact, it seems going downhill for her ever since...

[From [urlhttps://wnmawanama.itch.io/mid-century-butterfly]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在无限城这个城邦中，每个公民从出生起就被植入体内的纳米芯片，该芯片可以追踪他们的声望等级，这个系统决定了个人在彭罗斯集团（“公司”）统治的城市中成年后可以获得的各种机会——而░░░░░░也不例外。

她刚刚成年，现在已被视为系统的一部分。虽然年轻人在最终成为社会一部分时获得了一点优势作为“礼物”，但事情似乎对她来说并不好。事实上，从那以后她的处境似乎就在走下坡路……

[来自[urlhttps://wnmawanama.itch.io/mid- century-butterfly]itch.io[/url]]
